source_review.notes: Checked all four references: RFC 9110 status semantics, RFC 4918 as a WebDAV-only multistatus example, RFC 7644 as a SCIM-specific bulk example, and the current idempotency-key Internet-Draft explicitly labeled work in progress.

evidence: Reviewed inline set, quantifier, and mapping notation; symbols X, a, B, r_x, and V are defined before use.
notation_and_syntax.notes: GitHub inline math delimiters and TeX commands are valid.

evidence: Checked atomic all-success or all-not-applied formulation and best-effort mixed-outcome contrast.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The notation matches the prose without claiming distributed atomicity.

evidence: Reviewed zero/over-limit targets, stale selection, authorization revocation, partition commit, unknown effect, duplicate submission, and dependency cycle.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary cases are represented in exposition and examples.

evidence: Checked selection, atomicity, outcome, retry, and boundedness invariants against examples.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed bulk-versus-batch ownership, target selection timing, atomicity boundaries, and per-item outcome semantics.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed duplicate delivery, external-effect uncertainty, report pagination, authorization, dependency cycles, quotas, and partition failures.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed first-principles progression and ten distinct worked examples with five progressive exercises.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
